description: `loop.events`: one loop's journal as a window, oldest first — the same payloads a live subscriber received, read from the durable event table by loop id. With neither `before` nor `after` it is the LATEST window, which is what opening a loop needs; `hasOlder` says scrolling up finds more. `head` is the highest seq the daemon has allocated: subscribe from it and the window and the live tail join with no gap and no overlap. Streamed chunks (`model.delta`) are left out unless `includeDeltas` is set.
